<a id="fall_attack_refill_timer"></a>
### [`fall_attack_refill_timer`](../../../src/actor_workspace.asm#L8) `$4EEC`

*variable*

Actor workspace. init_game_variables clears $4EED-$4FE7 (contact_col0 .. burst_trap_row) at a game start. fall_attack_refill_timer: frame_update counts it down every frame; at 0 the three fall_attack_budget bytes are set to 2.

- **Read by:** [`frame_update`](frame_update.md#frame_update) [`$15BD`](../../../src/frame_update.asm#L31), [`frame_update`](frame_update.md#frame_update) [`$15CD`](../../../src/frame_update.asm#L38)
- **Written by:** [`frame_update`](frame_update.md#frame_update) [`$15CD`](../../../src/frame_update.asm#L38)

<a id="contact_col0"></a>
### [`contact_col0`](../../../src/actor_workspace.asm#L18) `$4EED-$4F03`

*variable*

Background contact tables of check_background_contact, one per mask column (23 bytes each). Index 0-15 = a 4-bit value made of two multicolour pixel codes of a background char under set sprite pixels (high nibble and low nibble of charset byte AND mask). A nonzero entry means the pair was seen. Entries 16-22 hold the pairs 3, 7, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15 (pairs with a %11 pixel) seen in chars whose colour RAM colour is not 0; the swap routines move them there. Image residue: $4EED-$4F3D hold a copy of the message bytes $4731-$4781 of an earlier build. At $4F2C the copy reads "DATASO", 6 zero bytes, "SENTS", $A0: the original text "DATASOFT PRESENTS" of message $62 (msg_presents), which this release changed to "DIABOLO  PRESENTS". init_game_variables clears it.
